notes:
GSTR-2B report now matches the GST portal's own format:

• New "ITC Available" and "ITC Not Available" FORM SUMMARY sheets — category-wise (B2B Invoices, Debit notes, ECO Documents, Reverse Charge, Credit notes net-off) with GSTR-3B table references, same structure as the portal's own download.
• New detail sheets: B2B, B2BA (amendments), B2B-CDNR (credit/debit notes), B2B-CDNRA, ECO — with GSTIN, invoice/document details, tax heads, ITC Availability and Amendment flags.
• ECO (e-commerce operator, Section 9(5)) invoices are now tracked as their own category instead of being lumped into B2B.
